theme: Young investor / first-timer: starting early, small amounts, ₹500/month
headline: Begin Your Investment Journey This Month
body: Starting with modest amounts like ₹500 monthly builds discipline and lets you experience market cycles early.
caption: Young investors gain a significant advantage by beginning early, regardless of investment size. Consistent small contributions compound over decades. Start today, not tomorrow. #YoungInvestor #StartSmall #CompoundingPower #InvestmentJourney #MoneyGrowth
